domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to create matching denominators before subtraction.
Tag for unlike denominators in pure-fraction subtraction or in the fractional parts of mixed numbers.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators already match and no equivalent-fraction conversion is performed.
Do not tag subtraction of numerators after denominators are already aligned.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator unless the step's main purpose is equivalent-fraction conversion for denominator matching.

skills.name: Normalize number form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as expressing a whole as a whole plus zero fraction or converting a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator to support later subtraction.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is converted to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when the rewrite prepares the quantities' forms before subtraction rather than carrying out subtraction itself.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary equivalent-fraction conversion whose purpose is only to create a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional parts into the answer.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities with a shared denominator and subtract any whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole-number parts of mixed numbers or rewritten whole-plus-fraction forms are subtracted.
Tag when a solution separates mixed-number subtraction into whole-part subtraction and fraction-part subtraction after setup is complete.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding a common denominator or converting to equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping that adjusts values after a negative fractional result appears.
Do not tag simplification or final presentation of the result.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fraction and adjust the whole-number part when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator fractional units and added to the fractional part.
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as x + 0/d before subtraction starts.
Do not tag simplification after regrouping is complete.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms or remove a zero fractional part when simplification is needed after subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced to lowest terms.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0 or when a mixed number with zero fractional part is rewritten as an integer.
Tag when the result is explicitly simplified after subtraction and before or during final reporting.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction step that produces the unsimplified result.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fraction parts if no reduction or zero-fraction simplification occurs.
Do not tag equivalent-fraction conversion done before subtraction.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole and fractional parts and express the answer in an appropriate final form such as a mixed number, fraction, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are recombined into a mixed number.
Tag when a result with whole part 0 is expressed as just a fraction, or when a zero fractional part is omitted in the final statement.
Tag when the solution explicitly presents the final answer form after arithmetic is complete.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag preliminary rewrites such as expressing a whole number as x + 0/d before subtraction.
Do not tag subtraction or borrowing steps themselves.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also serves to present the final answer form.
